behavioral_gates: Re-run probes on an unmodified RC1 binary when binaries become available; a source tag is not this gate.
Music requires loaded tags, complete published snapshots, metadata rescan policy and post-import userdata.
Piers deletes tracks on failed/partial plugin listing; native music rollout requires recovery tests and an explicit reliability decision.
Refresh may change native IDs and overwrite userdata: reconcile and restore before reporting success.
ScanFinished and immediate OK are insufficient without ownership-checked readback.
Future v23 builds require new behavioral qualification; version/method presence alone is insufficient.
